title: EU public tender alerts (TED)
description: Filter public contract notices published on Tenders Electronic Daily (TED). Only public, non-personal fields of each notice are returned.

cpvCodes.title: CPV codes
cpvCodes.description: Common Procurement Vocabulary codes to look for. Matching is hierarchical: 45000000 also returns every code below it, such as 45213150. Leave empty to accept any category.

countries.title: Buyer countries
countries.description: Three letter country codes of the buyers you care about, for example FRA, DEU, ESP, PRT. Leave empty to accept every country.

minValueEur.title: Minimum contract value (EUR)
minValueEur.description: Skip notices whose total value is below this amount in euros. Notices published without a value are skipped whenever this is above zero. Use 0 to keep every notice.

keywords.title: Title keywords
keywords.description: Words to look for in the notice title. A notice is kept when any one of them appears, ignoring upper and lower case. Leave empty to skip this filter.

publishedSince.title: Published since
publishedSince.description: Optional date, in the form YYYY-MM-DD, to look only at notices published on or after it. Leave empty to search every published notice.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Largest number of matching notices to store in the dataset for one run. Lower it to keep a run cheap and fast.
